description:
Step 2 of attaching a user image: register the uploaded image.

Call after PUTting the bytes to the presigned URL. `upload_url` is that
presigned `url` (the query string is dropped automatically). Attaches the
image's public URL to the session, so a following `design_chat` embeds it.
name: design_confirm_image_upload

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).

title: Confirm an image upload
